zh.title: 项目与开源贡献

zh.project_intro: 针对Agent长任务中断、重复调用和实验表述失真，构建持久化维护运行器、验收保护及MCP报告证据服务。
bullets: 连接SQLite检查点与隔离Git worktree；ext4正常执行和首检查点SIGKILL恢复产生相同参考补丁，创建状态或复用成功前拒绝NFS。
实现有界源码定位、原版测试验收、补丁/日志哈希校验及Linux验证后代回收；HTTP次数和JSON字节预留跨重启、修复轮次共享。
提供MCP2.3.0证据服务，隔离审计回执与额度；9,033字节独立wheel脱离源码安装，8项安装控制通过，原完整130项回归通过、零跳过。
接入LlamaIndex与外部MCP，句柄/回执不进模型输入；10场脚本模型与真实MCP控制通过（含原4场），状态异常后仍尝试关闭同一审计。
zh.project_scope: 恢复用参考计划，未证明自主修复。9B CPU本地报告审计3道已知题中2题通过结构契约，仍有文字歧义；外部MCP首题600秒超时、无有效提交，第二题未跑。GPU维护未启动；额度不是token/费用。

en.title: Projects and contributions
en.subtitle: Agent engineering / Recoverable execution / Tool reliability
en.project_intro: Build recoverable maintenance execution and a distributable MCP report service for interrupted agent jobs, repeated calls and auditable experimental claims.
bullets: Connect SQLite checkpoints and isolated Git worktrees. Ext4 normal and first-checkpoint SIGKILL runs yield the same reference patch; reject NFS before state creation or cached success.
Add bounded source navigation, original-test acceptance, patch/log hashes and Linux verifier descendant cleanup. Reserve HTTP attempts and JSON bytes across restarts and repair rounds.
Distribute an MCP2.3.0 service with isolated audit receipts and quotas: a 9,033-byte wheel passes eight installed-artifact controls outside the checkout; all 130 core checks pass with zero skips.

Integrate LlamaIndex with external MCP, keeping capabilities out of model prompts. Ten controls use scripted model replies with real MCP transport, including the original four; status faults no longer skip audit closure.
en.project_scope: Recovery uses reference plans; autonomous repair is unproven. A local 9B CPU audit meets the structured contract on 2/3 known queries, with a prose ambiguity. A later external-MCP query times out at 600s without submission; the second is not run. GPU maintenance never starts; quotas are not tokens/fees.

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: Preserve history after failed undo; reject same-path patch moves that delete files. Real permission/alias reproductions; 185 and 203 related checks pass separately.

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: Handle files disappearing during concurrent artifact deletion, retaining nested artifacts. Python 3.11/3.13 each pass the same 2,021 related tests with 26 expected failures.

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel (Python runtime)
contributions.text: Fix callback reentry deadlock (103 related checks) and cancelled-send idle shutdown hangs (97). Both retain 12 baseline broader failures; scopes are separate.

en.paper_text: First author. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 22, 2025. Lightweight object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery.
en.scope: Checked 2026-11-22: five open PRs, four drafts, none merged. Scopes are not added. Codex assisted implementation/verification; upstream human approval remains unverified. A bot COMMENTED review is not human approval.
